name: Maxone Semiconductor (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Maxone Semiconductor (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of semiconductor chip test probe cards in China and internationally. The company offers 2D and 2.5D MEMS, thin-film, vertical, and cantilever probe cards. It also engages in the research and development of space transfer substrates. Maxone Semiconductor (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
